-module(oracle_numeric_guard_and_match_spec_routes).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    yes=guard(-2.5), no=guard(wrong), lists:foreach(fun({Op,V,E})->{ok,E,[],[]}=erlang:match_spec_test({V},[{{'$1'},[],[{Op,'$1'}]}],table) end,[{abs,-2.5,2.5},{float,2,2.0},{round,-2.5,-3},{trunc,-2.5,-2},{ceil,-2.5,-2},{floor,-2.5,-3}]), {ok,1.0,[],[]}=erlang:match_spec_test({1.0,1},[{{'$1','$2'},[],[{min,'$1','$2'}]}],table),
    done.
guard(X) when abs(X)=:=2.5, float(X)=:= -2.5, round(X)=:= -3, trunc(X)=:= -2, ceil(X)=:= -2, floor(X)=:= -3, min(X,0)=:=X, max(X,0)=:=0 -> yes;
guard(_) -> no.
